from collections import Counter

def solve(grid):
    # Number of rows and columns
    n_rows = len(grid)
    n_cols = len(grid[0]) if n_rows else 0

    # Locate zero rows and columns (the separators)
    zero_rows = [i for i in range(n_rows) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[i])]
    zero_cols = [j for j in range(n_cols) if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i in range(n_rows))]

    # Build ranges for the three block rows
    block_rows = []
    start = 0
    for zr in zero_rows:
        if start <= zr - 1:
            block_rows.append((start, zr - 1))
        start = zr + 1
    if start <= n_rows - 1:
        block_rows.append((start, n_rows - 1))

    # Build ranges for the three block columns
    block_cols = []
    start = 0
    for zc in zero_cols:
        if start <= zc - 1:
            block_cols.append((start, zc - 1))
        start = zc + 1
    if start <= n_cols - 1:
        block_cols.append((start, n_cols - 1))

    # Extract the 2x2 blocks
    blocks = [[None for _ in range(len(block_cols))] for __ in range(len(block_rows))]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(block_rows):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(block_cols):
            blocks[i][j] = [[grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1]],
                            [grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]]

    # Determine the background value (the most frequent non‑zero value)
    non_zero = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0]
    background = Counter(non_zero).most_common(1)[0][0] if non_zero else 0

    # Relative positions inside a 2x2 block
    positions = [(0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1)]

    # Horizontal candidates: outer rows (leftmost & rightmost blocks) in the same block row
    horiz_candidates = {}  # value -> (block_row, di, dj)
    for i in range(len(block_rows)):
        left = blocks[i][0]
        right = blocks[i][2]
        for di, dj in positions:
            v = left[di][dj]
            if v != 0 and v != background and v == right[di][dj]:
                if v not in horiz_candidates or i < horiz_candidates[v][0]:
                    horiz_candidates[v] = (i, di, dj)

    # Vertical candidates: outer columns (topmost & bottommost blocks) in the same block column
    vert_candidates = {}  # value -> (block_col, di, dj)
    for j in range(len(block_cols)):
        if j != 0 and j != 2:          # only the outermost columns
            continue
        top = blocks[0][j]
        bottom = blocks[2][j]
        for di, dj in positions:
            v = top[di][dj]
            if v != 0 and v != background and v == bottom[di][dj]:
                if v not in vert_candidates or j < vert_candidates[v][0]:
                    vert_candidates[v] = (j, di, dj)

    # Apply horizontal fills (middle column = 1)
    mid_col = 1
    for v, (i, di, dj) in horiz_candidates.items():
        row = block_rows[i][0] + di
        col = block_cols[mid_col][0] + dj
        grid[row][col] = v

    # Apply vertical fills (middle row = 1)
    mid_row = 1
    for v, (j, di, dj) in vert_candidates.items():
        row = block_rows[mid_row][0] + di
        col = block_cols[j][0] + dj
        grid[row][col] = v

    return grid
